prompt: A latency sample is mostly unchanged, but one fast request becomes a very long timeout. The median stays fixed while the mean rises. What is the best interpretation?

options.text: The timeout has no operational importance because the median stayed fixed.
options.explanation: A robust centre can hide a painful tail event.

options.text: The mean now directly measures CPU service time.
options.explanation: Elapsed latency includes waiting and need not equal CPU work.

options.text: The total latency increased without a change to the middle of the sample.
options.explanation: A tail outlier can move the mean while leaving the middle sorted values unchanged.
The premise changes only one observation.

workedExample: The mean includes the timeout in its total; the median follows central ranks. Report both centre and tail information to avoid concluding that either every request slowed or nothing important happened.
